newsitem.title: BERMUDA: RenaissanceRe buying back $100 mln of stk.
newsitem.headline: RenaissanceRe buying back $100 mln of stk.

text.p: RenaissanceRe Holdings Ltd said Monday it was repurchasing $100 million of its common shares through two transactions.
The company said that on December 13 it repurchased 2,085,361 shares at $34.50 per share, for an aggregate price of $71.96 million, in private transactions with its founding institutional investors.
The company said it intends to begin a tender offer to purchase 813,190 shares at $34.50 per share, for an aggregate price of $28.06 million, from public shareholders.
After the both transactions, the percentage ownership interests of the founding institutional investors will be substantially the same as before the transactions, it said.
